title: Check a listing against the scan, then tour it
about: A CoStar researcher asks the agent to check a Houston listing against its scan.

vars.brief: I research properties for CoStar. Check what the listing claims about this house against the scan itself.

steps.say: A Houston house with a Matterport scan, a drone capture and a CoStar record.
The agent picks its tools, then reads the listing, the CoStar record and the scan side by side.

else.say: The agent is offline, so the claim check runs as a tool.

steps.say: Where the record and the scan disagree, the camera goes to the room.

steps.label: Play
steps.say: The tour walks through every finding on this scan.
Each stop is a finding, measured from the scan, with its source.
